sector_notes: Semiconductors and AI infrastructure remained the strongest five-session leadership (SOXX about +13.5%, SMH about +8.1%, QQQ about +4.9% from November 6 to 12), with AMD, AVGO, ANET, CLS and power/cooling suppliers showing strong price action. Breadth deteriorated sharply on November 12: 854 advancers versus 1,878 decliners among liquid US names, while SPY, QQQ and DIA fell roughly 0.3–0.4% and IWM fell about 1.6%; the sudden NVIDIA leadership transition adds event risk to the AI complex. Energy was the clearest sector winner on November 12 (XLE about +1.5%) and remained strong over the five-session window, while materials, industrials, financials and communication services weakened; favor selective longs rather than broad beta chasing.
